{{Quote|My team came to assist you. We discovered the outpost was destroyed and assumed the worst.|Fau-Kes|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
'''Fau-Kes''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the intelligence branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Fau-Kes was one of several SIS agents sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to help a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] locate the missing [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Nasan Godera]]. Although the agents were unable to locate Godera or the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the field, the Knight was successful in retrieving the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], and Fau-Kes escorted Godera back to the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Agent, bring Doctor Godera to Coruscant immediately. I'll brief him on the discovery at Ord Mantell.|General Var Suthra, to Fau-Kes|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
[[File:Resettlement_lab.png|thumb|left|250px|Godera's lab, which Fau-Kes's team found abandoned]]
Fau-Kes was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Rescue" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Fau-Kes led a group of SIS agents who were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]]. The agents were tasked with locating [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], a former Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], and the [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who had been sent to track down Godera; however, when Fau-Kes's team arrived at the [[Resettlement Zone laboratory|Godera laboratory]] that was the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] last known location, the SIS agents found it in ruins and filled with [[Death/Legends|dead]] Imperials. Fau-Kes returned to [[Olaris]], the Republic's main settlement on Taris, and coordinated the search from the [[Olaris Spaceport]]. During the search, the SIS agents received unconfirmed rumors that [[Watcher One]], a high-ranking member of the Sith Empire's [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], was on Taris.<ref name="The Rescue" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Fau-Kes was in the middle of a conversation with Suthra when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] along with Godera, whom the Jedi had rescued from Watcher One. The SIS agent questioned the Knight as to the details of Godera's rescue, and when the Jedi informed Fau-Kes that the Imperial [[operative]] had left the Empire's service, the Cathar promised to inform the [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS director]], [[Marcus Trant]], of the development. After Godera spoke with Suthra via Fau-Kes's [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], the general ordered Fau-Kes to bring the scientist to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] immediately, where Godera became Suthra's scientific [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]].<ref name="The Rescue" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality of traits==
Fau-Kes had [[Color/Legends|orange-brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was a trained operative of the Strategic Information Service.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Equipment==
While stationed on Taris, Fau-Kes wore gray clothing similar to many Taris settlers.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fau-Kes appears in the Jedi Knight-class mission "The Rescue" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears at the conclusion of the Jedi Knight-class storyline on Taris, taking custody of Doctor Godera and asking the player what happened to Watcher One. His response will vary depending on whether the player killed Watcher One or let the Imperial operative live.<ref name="The Rescue" />
